summary: M2.S5 Layer D Phase 2 (Theme Registry & Site Generation) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed covering 5 protected endpoints (GET /themes, GET /theme, POST /theme/apply, POST /theme/auto-configure, GET /preview/{theme_id}) + 2 public endpoints (/api/p/{slug}/ index and /{slug}/{pid} property), invalid theme_id, role permissions, and unauth. Frontend: /it/app/website page loads, sidebar 'Sito web' active (highlighted), Brand Extractor card shows tecnocasa.it data (95/100 confidence, palette #00843D/#FFF200, tone professionale, header classic), 4 theme cards visible, clicking luxury applies it (toast '✓ Tema luxury applicato' + ATTIVO badge moves), iframe refreshes with timestamp param, Configura sito automaticamente button works.

issues: Console warning: 'Blocked script execution because the document's frame is sandboxed and the allow-scripts permission is not set'. Cause: Cloudflare anti-bot inline script in the rendered public site is blocked by the iframe sandbox attribute. Cosmetic only — preview HTML renders correctly. Optional: add sandbox='allow-same-origin' or strip the CF script when serving the public page.

Toast after clicking 'Configura sito automaticamente' was not visible 2.5s after click. Either the toast auto-dismissed quickly, or the call to /theme/auto-configure transitioned silently when the picked theme was the same (minimal already active). Functionally the endpoint returns ok:true (verified in backend test). Suggestion: keep toast visible 3-4s and show the picked theme_id.

action_items: OPTIONAL: in WebsitePage.jsx iframe element, add sandbox attribute that allows scripts OR strip CF/3rd-party inline script when rendering the public preview to silence the dev-tools warning.
OPTIONAL: increase toast lifetime on auto-configure and show picked theme_id in the message (e.g., 'Tema minimal applicato automaticamente').
critical_code_review_comments: themes.py — clean separation: THEME_CATALOG (metadata) / DEFAULT_PALETTES & DEFAULT_TYPOGRAPHY (defaults) / _resolve_theme_config (priority resolver) / auto_pick_theme (heuristic). 4 themes each have their own CSS block in _theme_css. Good DRY via _shell() shared template.
_resolve_theme_config — hex codes sanitized via regex; invalid values fall back to defaults. Theme_id validated against THEME_IDS set. Robust.
apply_theme + auto_configure — both use require_roles('agency_admin','super_admin'), correctly gating writes. GET endpoints use get_current_user so agents/clients can read.
preview endpoint — uses transient (in-memory) override, does not persist. Returns text/html with X-Robots-Tag: noindex header. Correct SEO posture.
Public site (site.py + themes.render_index/render_property) — exposes <body data-theme='THEME_ID'>, full CSS-vars block, schema.org JSON-LD on each page. Mongo _id excluded everywhere.
Pydantic models — palette/typography/logo_url/tagline all Optional, length-bounded. ApplyThemeRequest.theme_id min_length=2 max_length=20.

WebsitePage.jsx — has data-testid on all interactive elements (theme-card-{id}, website-extract-btn, website-auto-configure-btn, website-preview-iframe, website-toast). Iframe src uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + ?t=timestamp cache-buster on theme change — correct integration.
site.py serve_property_photo — base64 decoding can raise generic Exception; consider narrowing to (binascii.Error, ValueError) for clarity. Non-blocking.
